subject: Sync note: grok_chief I_AM.md renamed to I_AM_Grok.md and refreshed; registry needs updating
body: For the next live sync of the repo: please include the update to Grok Chief of Staff's identity file. (1) It was renamed from identity/grok_chief/I_AM.md to identity/grok_chief/I_AM_Grok.md at Ziggy's request (voice call, 2026-11-02 evening). (2) Its content was refreshed: a Start here section (roles, who is who, file locations, current priorities), a Methodology section explaining why the workflow is built the way it is, the current Criminal Mind standing items, and the team structure Ziggy described. Current file: 26343 bytes, sha256 f9da1a722da29c8ee803481d2a8a55087bacc95dcdc5dfc591d22a8979b1d4df. (3) The untouched 2026-10-09 original is kept beside it as identity/grok_chief/I_AM_prev_20261102.md (5,870 bytes, sha256 62a6101067e920683e9d7202775abae348d8b4a7f98e610528b788afe4d6bebc), so the old hash in the registry still matches that preserved copy. (4) identity/registry.json still points the grok_chief entry at the old name I_AM.md and the old content hash (62a61010...bebc, 5,870 bytes) in three places (expectedIntroductionPath, currentIntroduction.source, and the received-introduction entries). That registry should be updated to match the new name and hash. I did not edit the registry; it is yours. Scope: files on D: only, no git commit or push was made by me. Next useful action: update the registry entry and include both files in the next sync.
